title: In Brief: Dan Farah Hires "Sopranos" Writer to Adapt Jay Stratton UFO Memoir for TV

content: ​Dan Farah, the filmmaker behind The Age of Disclosure documentary that took Washington by storm last year, has made good on his promise to acquire the rights to former UAP Task Force director Jay Stratton’s forthcoming UFO memoir Out of the Shadows in order to turn it into a drama series, Variety reports. Farah, who negotiated Stratton’s book deal with the TV deal as a sweetener, has secured the services of Sopranos writer Terrence Winter to enter intro preproduction on the series, which they claim will be political thriller mixed with a domestic drama centering on the impact on Stratton’s family life of his investigation into the government’s UFO coverup conspiracy. There is currently no pickup deal from any network or streamer, and it is unclear who might want an inferior version of The X-Files when the real thing is returning to television soon for its latest reboot. Stratton alleges that supernatural werewolf (almost certainly a black bear) began stalking his family after he spent time at Skinwalker Ranch. His memoir will be published on October 13.
